main_parameters.name: Attack Time
main_parameters.description: Adjusts the time after a key is pressed from when the note starts to sound until it reaches maximum volume. A larger value specifies a slower attack.
main_parameters.description_es: Tiempo entre pulsar la tecla y alcanzar el volumen máximo. Un valor mayor produce un ataque más lento.

main_parameters.name: Release Time
main_parameters.description: Adjusts how long notes linger after keyboard keys are released. A larger values specifies a longer release.
main_parameters.description_es: Duración de la nota después de soltar la tecla. Un valor mayor prolonga el sonido.

main_parameters.name: Cutoff Frequency
main_parameters.description: Adjusts timbre by attenuating the components of a note’s frequency characteristics that are higher than a certain frequency (cutoff frequency). A larger value specifies a brighter, harder sound, while a lower value specifies a mellower, softer sound.
main_parameters.description_es: Atenúa las frecuencias superiores al corte. Un valor mayor da un sonido más brillante; uno menor, más suave.

main_parameters.name: Resonance
main_parameters.description: Adjusts the gain of harmonic tones in the vicinity of the cutoff frequency specified above. A larger value creates a more unusual sound.
main_parameters.description_es: Realza los armónicos cercanos a la frecuencia de corte. Un valor mayor acentúa la resonancia.

main_parameters.name: Vibrato Type
main_parameters.description_es: Selecciona la forma de onda del vibrato.

main_parameters.name: Vibrato Depth
main_parameters.description_es: Intensidad de la variación de afinación del vibrato.

main_parameters.name: Vibrato Rate
main_parameters.description_es: Velocidad de la variación de afinación del vibrato.

main_parameters.name: Vibrato Delay
main_parameters.description: Adjusts the time until vibrato starts after a note is sounded.
main_parameters.description_es: Tiempo que tarda en comenzar el vibrato después de tocar una nota.

main_parameters.name: Octave Shift
main_parameters.description: Shifts the pitch upwards or downwards in octave steps.
main_parameters.description_es: Transporta la afinación en pasos de una octava.

main_parameters.name: Volume
main_parameters.description: Specifies the volume level of a tone. A larger value sets a higher volume level.
main_parameters.description_es: Nivel de volumen del tono. Un valor mayor aumenta el volumen.

main_parameters.name: Velocity Sense
main_parameters.description: VSpecifies how much the tone and/or volume should be affected by keyboard touch (pressure). A larger positive value specifies more brightness and greater volume as keyboard touch becomes stronger. A larger negative value specifies more softness and less volume as keyboard touch becomes stronger. A value of 0 specifies no change in accordance with keyboard touch.
main_parameters.description_es: Respuesta del timbre y volumen a la fuerza de pulsación. Los valores positivos aumentan brillo y volumen al tocar más fuerte; los negativos invierten la respuesta. Cero elimina esta variación.

main_parameters.name: Reverb Send
main_parameters.description: Specifies how much reverb is applied to a tone.
main_parameters.description_es: Cantidad del tono enviada a reverberación.

main_parameters.name: Chorus Send
main_parameters.description: Specifies how much chorus is applied to a tone.
main_parameters.description_es: Cantidad del tono enviada al chorus.

main_parameters.name: Delay Send
main_parameters.description: Specifies how much delay is applied to a tone.
main_parameters.description_es: Cantidad del tono enviada al retardo.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound A Timbre Type
advanced_parameters.description: Timbre type of Sound A: melody/drum/piano/versatile (hex-layer). Sound A is dedicated to playing note-on events, providing the primary tone when a note is initiated.
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Tipo de timbre del sonido A
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de tipo de timbre del sonido a. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound B Timbre Type
advanced_parameters.description: Timbre type of Sound B: melody/drum/piano/versatile (hex-layer). Sound B is utilized for various supplementary events, such as note-off or double-stop effects, depending on the specific tone
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Tipo de timbre del sonido B
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de tipo de timbre del sonido b. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound A Wavetable
advanced_parameters.description: Wavetable of Sound A. Sound A is dedicated to playing note-on events, providing the primary tone when a note is initiated.
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Tabla de ondas del sonido A
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de tabla de ondas del sonido a. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound B Wavetable
advanced_parameters.description: Wavetable of Sound B. Sound B is utilized for various supplementary events, such as note-off or double-stop effects, depending on the specific tone
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Tabla de ondas del sonido B
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de tabla de ondas del sonido b. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Monophonic Mode
advanced_parameters.description: In monophonic mode, the synthesizer produces only one note at a time, regardless of how many keys are pressed. If multiple keys are pressed simultaneously or in succession, the most recent key pressed takes priority and becomes the only note that sounds.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de modo monofónico. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Portamento
advanced_parameters.description: Portamento lets the sound slide smoothly from one note to the next instead of jumping.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Desliza la afinación suavemente entre notas.

advanced_parameters.name: Portamento Time
advanced_parameters.description: Portamento time controls how long it takes to slide from one note to another. A shorter time makes the slide quick, while a longer time creates a slow, smooth glide.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Duración del deslizamiento de afinación entre notas. Un valor mayor produce una transición más lenta.

advanced_parameters.name: Velocity to Cutoff
advanced_parameters.description: Controls how velocity affects the filter cutoff (certain wavetables only).
advanced_parameters.description_es: Cómo afecta la pulsación a la frecuencia de corte. Depende de la tabla de ondas.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound B for Note-off
advanced_parameters.description: Sound B is triggered when a key is released, producing a sound specifically for the note-off action. This adds detail or effects to the end of a note, such as a fade, click, or other textures.
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Sonido B al soltar la tecla
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de sonido b al soltar la tecla. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Note-off velocity
advanced_parameters.description: This refers to how the speed at which you press and release a key affects the velocity of Sound B.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de pulsación al soltar la tecla. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Sound B for Double-stop
advanced_parameters.description: Sound B is triggered when two notes are played together, simulating the effect of a double-stop, as used in string instruments.
advanced_parameters.display_name_es: Sonido B al tocar dos notas
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de sonido b al tocar dos notas. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Stretch Tuning
advanced_parameters.description: Specifies the stretch tuning, also known as the Railsback curve. A value of 0 is recommended for most instruments, while values from 1 to 7 may be suitable for piano or electric piano sounds.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Ajuste de afinación extendida. Consulte los valores disponibles en este control.

advanced_parameters.name: Output Route
advanced_parameters.description: Send the tone directly to the output or through the DSP effect.
advanced_parameters.description_es: Envía el tono directamente a la salida o a través del efecto DSP.
